kind: exact source quote plus multilingual NLI acceptance
hypothesis: Can an exact-quote turnstile plus multilingual DeBERTa keep the nine grounded Qwen candidates and reject the seventeen unsupported candidates from Gate 16G.6?

inputs.label_rule: The private human audit published in the immutable Gate 16G.6 result is frozen before this run: the nine usable FOUND rows from expected chats are grounded; all seventeen distractor FOUND rows are unsupported or describe another case.

pipeline: reuse each frozen Qwen claim and only the source messages it cited in Gate 16G.6
ask the same Qwen3-8B to copy one exact contiguous quote that proves the entire claim or return NO_QUOTE
ordinary code requires the message ID to be one of the frozen cited IDs and the quote to be an exact substring no longer than 600 characters
ordinary code builds the largest deterministic source window around that quote that fits the NLI model
multilingual mDeBERTa compares the source window with the original claim
accept only the entailment class; reject contradiction, neutral, NO_QUOTE and malformed output
compare every decision with the frozen private human label
privacy: Conversation text, exact quotes, claims, message IDs, raw model output and private paths remain private. Public output contains only aggregate decisions and manually reviewed safe explanations.
claim_boundary: This is a development test on labels opened by the previous human audit. Passing can justify a fresh locked replication; it cannot establish production accuracy.
